features.title: Application Intake for Age and Disease Data

openQuestions.text: What exact age data element is required: date of birth, age in years, age range, or another representation?
What exact disease data elements are required to satisfy the "minimum necessary" standard?
How is "minimum necessary" defined for this feature at the field level?
Who is the intended actor for data entry: applicant, member, dependent, agent, internal user, or another role?
What permissions or access controls apply to viewing, entering, editing, and submitting this intake data?
What application type and platform are targeted: web, mobile, desktop, API, or mixed?
What specific UI flow, screens, and field validations are required?
What error states and validation messages are required when data is missing or invalid?
Is disease information expected to use free text, enumerated choices, structured codes, yes/no disclosure, or another format?
Are any age- or disease-related fields optional versus required?
Are there any legal, privacy, consent, audit, retention, or regional handling requirements for this health information?
Is an API required for this feature, and if so, what are the endpoint, method, payload, response, and authentication requirements?
Does the intake require save-and-resume, draft handling, review-before-submit, or post-submit confirmation?
What security controls satisfy the "secure digital intake" requirement for this feature?
